# Existing Model/relay living scalar adapter — implementation acceptance

**2026-10-27 · base1184859/Source07389324 · ENGINEERING ONLY.** Extends the bound [allocation contract](support-allocation-contract.md)/[design](support-allocation-design.json), not a research registration or selected protocol change. Canonical task remains BACKLOG. Archive unchanged Source/examples before code.

## Owner/interface

Two small flat owned modules: living-experiment-config.mjs for strict engine/reference/config/metric/no-draw vocabulary; living-experiment.mjs for the fixed paid reference orchestration/public candidate and passive measurements. Existing experiment-config/experiment/discovery compose them; evidence/worker statistical method unchanged. No domain import of studies/tests, no generic runner/plugin/framework, no new Model/court API. Keep old packets/programs/source guards immutable; the old admission-refusal script remains historical Source07389324 evidence, not a runnable current-source acceptance promise.

Complete config exactly engine/reference/days/seed/includeState/maxActions/successCriterion/supportAllocation. Engine native-living-accountability/v1; reference support-allocation-control/v1; H365; allocation concentrated/dispersed; explicit identity-only seed; Boolean diagnostic state; safe integer maxActions1..100000; unbound success only. Existing experimentParameter/manifest/statistic/parallel scalar paths must recognize the engine and reject cross-engine metrics/legacy coercion/includeState confirmation/drift. New generator:none manifest is separately named, not a new layout for old generators. Repeated labels are not independent worlds.

Use actual60zero-wealth supplied roots, exact fee1/maturity/ordinary native defaults/26invitation opportunities and unchanged5case calendar from design, existing d77-timed-act-settled-history/v1. Generate the fixed support plan arithmetically in its owner (do not import frozen study data at runtime). Common public candidate selects accepted willing n00–n39, not target/prior entrant, XP strictly above last entrant's CURRENT public XP, liquid≥ceil(lastStake*1.1), maxXP/tie SubjectId. No evaluator fields consumed. The selector may have a narrow public export for pure public-input golden tests; it grants no admission itself. Same stance/no-fallback policy both arms; actual native entry still verifies source/status/funds/work. Private local target facts are passive measurement only, not whole-chain verdicts.

## Clock/budget/missingness

Each actual top-level Model caller or Relay command attempt counts once before execution; no nested controller/read/audit double counting or refill. Clock advances count; cap checked before the next command, preserving any real partial proposal/round, NOT rolling it back or pretending it completed. Unexpected errors propagate; explicit unsupported Model/relay states are retained as refusal/coverage/censor, not safe zeros. Ordinary XP/cash refusal is a recorded procedural event, not fabricated merits. Audits remain independent at each event hour, after each completed funding round/procedural command and at final/censored state, retaining the historical caller cadence rather than adding an unneeded full replay to every individual artifact/issue call. Cap cannot trigger a future maturity/clock advance. Horizon declared8760 remains even on first-command censor.

History:365expected daily endpoints24..8760 (dailySampleOffsetHours24). Rows after that day's actor commands, except terminalH advances/audits only; no extraHissuance/withdrawal. An interrupted same-hour round has no fabricated completed daily endpoint. runStatistic returns null for censored/missing runs; actual births measured, never assert86 or missing=0. Store physical Model state/command/funding/custody/relay records only when includeState:true; scalar worker payload stays value(s)/censor/seed only. Actual refunds/debt/source recovery/paused slots/Relay work remain distinct. Add explicit coverage counters alongside the proposed seven living scalars if needed to prevent unknown case regions looking safe; no forced truthful win.

## Validation ceiling BEFORE any full control run

Native prefixes only at maxActions≤3000, before first day75case (60ordinary sources/day guarantee this bound under fixed reference). No annual new arm, ACT outcome probe, scientific confirmation, real registration/reserved world/search. Test strict config/dispatch/scalars/manifest/workers, nonvacuous native14funding rounds against separately captured static oracle, actual paid birth before cap, current public-candidate pure vectors including ignored evaluator getters, prefix limits/missingness/seed no-draw invariance, and source/cash/fees/XP/history/audit accounting. Engineering-only temporary v2 validation objects may check schema/verification, NEVER run reserved labels as scientific data.

Before current Source mutation reuse old separately archived Source and fixed legacy/default/keyed/timed caller proofs; after code refresh full/current+21original isolated historical/focused/DAG/two fixed trajectories/default/keyed/old D77/timed preservation. Do not rerun historical Source as current proof or rewrite old packets/expectations. Old fixed365day v1 caller may be used as a declared COMPATIBILITY workload (not either NEW allocation/candidate arm): same complete output excluding only implementation identity. Current registration Source digest legitimately changes; old evidence remains pinned. No old quiet-year optimization/other programme fallback.

After adapter correctness: actual scientific sampling/claims/error/precision/held-out/kills/master G1→G2/G3/G5→G4 still absent. Adapter success cannot authorize the comparative research or claim human cooperation/10×/viability/verified usefulness. This cohort stops at typed scalar admission and censored pre-case engineering evidence.
